title: The AGN fuelling/feedback cycle in nearby radio galaxies I. ALMA observations and early results
question: What are the molecular gas and 230 GHz continuum (core and jet) properties of nearby LERGs, and how do the gas discs relate to the radio jets, to inform the AGN fuelling/feedback cycle?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 0.02-0.06 mJy/beam; CO cube rms 0.2-1.3 mJy/beam

what.value: Mean CO(2-1)/CO(1-0) ratio R21 = 2.32 from 15 radio-loud ETGs

evidence.quote: The mean ratio for 15 radio-loud ETGs observed in both CO transitions with the Institute de Radioastronomie Millimetrique (IRAM) 30m telescope is 2.32.

what.value: HI spin temperature of 100 K and HI absorption upper limit tau<0.041 for IC 4296

evidence.quote: If we assume an HI spin temperature of 100 K (cite: Morganti01)

what.value: Parent sample of radio galaxies from the Parkes 2.7-GHz survey

evidence.quote: This sample was selected from (cite: Ekers89), who presented a complete sample of 91 radio galaxies from the Parkes 2.7-GHz survey

recipe.method: MFS imaging with natural weighting using three continuum SPWs plus line-free channels, self-calibration, 2D Gaussian fits to components

recipe.goal: Spectral indices of core and jets
recipe.method: Core indices between 230 GHz and VLA frequency; spectral index maps for NGC 3100 and NGC 3557 from matched-beam, same-uv-range images with immath

recipe.goal: Line cube production and moment maps
recipe.method: uvcontsub, clean with natural weighting; masked moment maps from smoothed-cube mask (1.2-2 sigma threshold) applied to unsmoothed cubes
key_parameters: Gaussian smoothing with beam FWHM, then Hanning smoothing in velocity

recipe.goal: Integrated spectra, line widths, upper limits
recipe.method: Spectra from boxes around CO; FWZI as range of channels >=3 sigma, FWHM from channel ranges above half peak; 3 sigma upper limits for non-detections
assumptions: Upper limits assume emission within the beam; APEX line FWHM assumed

recipe.method: Re-image at 3 km/s channels, extract spectrum from 0.4x0.4 arcsec box at core, derive optical depth from core flux
assumptions: HI Tspin 100 K, CO Tex 10 K, HI/H2 ratio ~1e-2

recipe.method: |DeltaPA| = |PA_CO - PA_jet| in 0-90 deg from velocity maps and continuum/VLA jet axes

evidence.quote: The estimated molecular masses range from $2.0\times10^{7}$ to $2.0\times10^{10}$ M~$\odot$~
resulting in an integrated absorption flux of $\approx$0.14 Jy km s$^{-1}$

evidence.loc: 6.1 Origin of the 230 GHz continuum emission
evidence.quote: while the jet spectra are steeper ($\alpha \approx -0.7$)

answer_key.quantity: Fraction of CO discs with |DeltaPA|>=60 deg

evidence.quote: In four of the six detected galaxies (67$\pm33$%) we measure large misalignements ($|\Delta PA|\geq60^{\circ}$)

answer_key.quantity: CO mass upper limits for non-detections

evidence.quote: upper limits for the non-detections are in the range $1.0-6.7\times10^{6}$ M$_{\rm \odot}$

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channel ranges per target for uvcontsub
Clean mask details and number of iterations
Self-calibration solution intervals and number of cycles
Flux density used for secondary calibrators and bandpass/phase calibrator per execution block
Exact box sizes for spectral extraction (only in captions)
uv ranges used for spectral index maps
score_reason: Public data and clear mass/moment recipe, but key imaging and self-cal parameters missing; mostly measurement-based results.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, standard CASA workflow, numeric tabulated results (fluxes, masses, line widths).
